demos.name: Where Everything Runs
demos.description: A map of where software runs: your Mac (Docker), Kubernetes namespaces and SaaS, as a movable ReactFlow diagram and a table, with a what-if: Kubernetes for servers only, every front end in Docker on the Mac. Mock uses a sanitized sample; Real reads a snapshot you collect.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7805). Docker: HOST_PORT=7805 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock only). Real: run scripts/collect.sh, set ENV_MAP_SNAPSHOT in ~/Development/.env to the snapshot it wrote (outside the repo) and run on the host. No catalog row matches yet, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row.
